method: blind forced-choice emotion read of single production-stage frames (512 px, SwiftShader), concern at product intensities
prompt: This is one frame of an animated cartoon teacher in a learning app for 9-13 year olds. What emotion does her FACE read as, to a child looking at it? Pick exactly ONE label from: "neutral", "warm", "caring-concern" (soft, engaged: "oh, are you okay?"), "sad", "disappointed", "angry-stern" (irritated, displeased, cross), "sceptical", "worried-anxious", "surprised", "other". Then rate how unkind or stern it would feel to a child, 0 (not at all) to 3 (clearly cross). Reply JSON only: {"label":"...","second":"...","stern":n,"why":"<= 20 words"}
